note: Every first-party skill directory is skills/<category>-<name>. New skills, and any skill you rename, must use one of these prefixes. The legacy list is for skills not renamed yet: it may only shrink.

categories.git-: Commits, pull requests, releases, branch sync, issue triage.
categories.legacy-: Behaviour-preserving change in old systems, and doc realignment.
categories.media-: Images, video, audio and asset handling.
categories.ops-: Session tooling, delivery pipelines and verification.
categories.research-: Finding the right skill, investigating a question.
